batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-a-2013-2014-set1.pdf (7 pp.). The printed header (p.1) reads: A-ইউনিট, ১ম বর্ষ (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, ২০১৩-২০১৪, কম্পিউটার সায়েন্স এন্ড ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় — boxed 'Set CODE: 1', সময়ঃ ৪৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমান- ৬০. The Drive listing label 'Set-1' agrees with the printed code, but the paper is a DEPARTMENT paper (Computer Science and Engineering), not a general A-unit set: 60 questions — Bangla Q1-8, English Q9-15, Higher Mathematics Q16-23 and Q25-38, ICT Q24, Physics Q39-60 (subjects assigned per question by content; no subject sections are printed). The compilation prints a boxed key beside each question (উত্তরঃ + Bangla letter for Bangla-medium questions; 'Ans:' + Latin letter for the English questions and inside some Solve boxes) and worked 'Solve:' boxes for most mathematics/physics questions; question text here is stem + options only. 59 of 60 questions keyed; Q57's key letter is cut off by the scan's page edge and is recorded keyless. Two questions (Q22, Q26) carry an internal conflict between the boxed key and the printed Solve — the boxed key is recorded and the conflict documented, per project precedent for these scans. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 13 of 60 questions verified. row 1: excluded (DIFFER) row 2: excluded (DIFFER) row 3: excluded (DIFFER) row 6: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 7: excluded (DIFFER) row 8: excluded (DIFFER) row 10: excluded (DIFFER) row 11: excluded (DIFFER) row 13: excluded (DIFFER) row 14: excluded (DIFFER) row 15: key conflict - Satt key (c) recorded, answer unverified row 17: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 18: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 19: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 20: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 21: excluded (DIFFER) row 22: excluded (DIFFER) row 23: excluded (DIFFER) row 26: excluded (DIFFER) row 28: excluded (DIFFER) row 29: excluded (DIFFER) row 31: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 32: excluded (DIFFER) row 33: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 34: excluded (DIFFER) row 35: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 36: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 37: excluded (DIFFER) row 38: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (DIFFER) row 40: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 42: excluded (DIFFER) row 43: excluded (DIFFER) row 44: excluded (DIFFER) row 45: excluded (DIFFER) row 46: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 48: excluded (DIFFER) row 49: excluded (DIFFER) row 50: excluded (DIFFER) row 51: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 52: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 54: excluded (DIFFER) row 55: excluded (DIFFER) row 56: excluded (DIFFER) row 57: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 58: excluded (DIFFER) row 59: excluded (DIFFER) row 60: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC)

sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint of the JU A Unit 2013-2014 Computer Science and Engineering department admission paper (printed Set CODE: 1). Aggregator header 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com', footer 'Get all University Info From www.admissionwar.com' and diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper; the watermark overlaps a few key boxes and option texts (each such case was zoom-checked and is noted on the question). Downstream cross-check partner (not used here): Satt Academy's JU A 2013-14 Set-3 bank (subcat 7143, stated 60) and the A year bank — identity to be settled at question level.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): A-ইউনিট; ১ম বর্ষ (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, ২০১৩-২০১৪; কম্পিউটার সায়েন্স এন্ড ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগ; জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, সাভার, ঢাকা; boxed set label 'Set CODE: 1'; সময়ঃ ৪৫ মিনিট; পূর্ণমান- ৬০. Printed instructions (বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্যঃ, partly overlapped by the aggregator watermark): all 60 questions are to be answered; ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে for each wrong answer; answers go on the supplied OMR sheet in black ballpoint; no calculator (and no scientific calculator) may be used; at the start of the exam the candidate must copy two sentences onto the OMR sheet — (ক) যেমন কর্ম তেমন ফল (খ) As you sow, so you reap.
